LanguageData.WotF_Backstory_ArcaneScholar.description: One of the few elves permitted to study advanced magic and hold access to the ruin archives. Though she normally spends her days buried among old books and workbenches, whenever the need arises, her staff unleashes devastating spells without hesitation.
LanguageData.WotF_Backstory_ArcaneScholar.title: arcane scholar
LanguageData.WotF_Backstory_Archon.description: A leader who represents a settlement in diplomacy and oversees its affairs. [PAWN_nameDef] spends most days buried in paperwork and negotiations; only when the settlement's survival hangs in the balance does she don long-sealed heavy armor and draw upon strictly restricted, high-risk spells.
LanguageData.WotF_Backstory_Archon.title: Court archon
LanguageData.WotF_Backstory_Beekeeper.description: [PAWN_nameDef] tends beehives and a few gentle small animals in a clearing at the settlement's edge, her clothes carrying a faint sweet scent year-round. Come harvest season, even the stern-faced guards have to stay on her good side if they want to beg a small jar of honey.
LanguageData.WotF_Backstory_Beekeeper.title: beekeeper
LanguageData.WotF_Backstory_Bookworm.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent nearly all her free time in the settlement's library. Though the yellowed old manuals on the shelves were so obscure that even the adults rarely bothered with them, she refused to put them down, sometimes forgetting to eat while trying to make sense of a strange diagram.
LanguageData.WotF_Backstory_Bookworm.title: bookworm
LanguageData.WotF_Backstory_CourierChild.description: Elven settlements rarely communicate by radio; everyday messages travel on foot. Young [PAWN_nameDef] spent her days darting between outposts with letters tucked in her coat, building strong legs and learning along the way how to see off any wild beast blocking the trail.
LanguageData.WotF_Backstory_CourierChild.title: courier
LanguageData.WotF_Backstory_CourtTrader.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is one of the few elves who regularly lead caravans between elven settlements and human towns. Skilled at trading crafts and herbs for uncommon fabrics and wares from outside, she returns from every trip with packed saddlebags and a head full of rumors.
LanguageData.WotF_Backstory_CourtTrader.title: Court trader
LanguageData.WotF_Backstory_CuriousChild.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was full of curiosity about the outside world and regularly slipped past the settlement's outskirts whenever her elders looked away. Those wanderings taught her early how to deal with strangers—and finally which herbs to pluck in a hurry for a scraped knee.
LanguageData.WotF_Backstory_CuriousChild.title: curious child
LanguageData.WotF_Backstory_ForestCook.description: Even though eating raw berries never upsets her stomach, [PAWN_nameDef] remains obsessed with heat control and seasoning. Give her a single iron pot and she can simmer ordinary mushrooms, honey, and game into an aroma that stops passersby in their tracks.
LanguageData.WotF_Backstory_ForestCook.title: forest cook
LanguageData.WotF_Backstory_FruitSneak.description: The adults always used magic to help gather berries and herbs, and [PAWN_nameDef] quickly picked up the technique—though most of the time she was quietly coaxing the sweetest berries and tenderest shoots into her own pockets, then sneaking off to eat them as snacks.
LanguageData.WotF_Backstory_FruitSneak.title: fruit sneak
LanguageData.WotF_Backstory_Herbalist.description: [PAWN_nameDef] prefers treating injuries with gentle stanching spells and herbal salves. Whenever she hears how outside clinics jump straight to scalpels and bone saws, she cannot help frowning at how crude it all sounds.
LanguageData.WotF_Backstory_Herbalist.title: herbal physician
LanguageData.WotF_Backstory_Hunter.description: [PAWN_nameDef] drives off dangerous beasts that wander too close to the settlement, keeping the storerooms supplied with hides and meat along the way. Once a creature leaves a track in the mud, she can follow it unhurriedly all the way to its den.
LanguageData.WotF_Backstory_Hunter.title: hunter
LanguageData.WotF_Backstory_Idler.description: [PAWN_nameDef] firmly believes that with centuries of life ahead, there is no real reason to rush today's chores. Whenever no one is watching, she can sit quietly in trance beneath the shade of a tree all morning, only getting up slowly now and then to hand someone a tool.
LanguageData.WotF_Backstory_Idler.title: lazybones
LanguageData.WotF_Backstory_MachineSpiritMender.descr: The settlement's few heirloom refrigerators and water purifiers all depend on [PAWN_nameDef]. Though she has no idea how the humming parts inside those iron casings actually work, a few ritual marks and two well-placed taps with a wooden mallet somehow always get the stubborn old machines running again.
LanguageData.WotF_Backstory_MachineSpiritMender.title: appliance mender
mender
LanguageData.WotF_Backstory_ManuscriptKeeper.descript: [PAWN_nameDef] sorts and mends the old books and tattered pages handed down through the settlement. Almost no one can fully make sense of those strangely formatted documents, yet anyone who casually dog-ears a page will hear about it from her for the rest of the day.
LanguageData.WotF_Backstory_ManuscriptKeeper.title: manuscript keeper
LanguageData.WotF_Backstory_MartialEnthusiast.descrip: While other children were still splashing around by the stream catching fish, [PAWN_nameDef] was already pestering the guards every day to teach her the bow and sword. In her mind, however, striking a dashing opening stance sometimes mattered more than whether her arrow hit the bullseye.
LanguageData.WotF_Backstory_MartialEnthusiast.title: martial enthusiast
LanguageData.WotF_Backstory_NurseryKeeper.description: [PAWN_nameDef] looks after the settlement's herb beds and young saplings, able to tell at a glance which plant needs water and which patch of soil needs turning. Once the chores are done, her favorite pastime is leaning back in the shade of a tree for a quiet nap.
LanguageData.WotF_Backstory_NurseryKeeper.title: nursery keeper
LanguageData.WotF_Backstory_PigmentMaker.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spends her days in the workshop washing pale stone and grinding minerals and herbs to mix ritual chalk and pigments for illustration. After years of handling mineral dust, faint stains beneath her fingernails never quite wash clean.
LanguageData.WotF_Backstory_PigmentMaker.title: pigment maker
LanguageData.WotF_Backstory_QuarryWorker.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spends her days quarrying along cliff faces, cutting stone for the settlement's roads and walls and gathering the minerals needed for chalk. By quitting time her pockets are usually weighed down with a few bright-colored scraps of ore she picked up along the way.
LanguageData.WotF_Backstory_QuarryWorker.title: quarry worker
LanguageData.WotF_Backstory_Ranger.description: An elven archer who patrols the outer edges of the territory. Accustomed to moving silently through shadow and brush with a longbow slung across her back, [PAWN_nameDef] keeps watch for uninvited guests trying to slip past the outposts into the interior.
LanguageData.WotF_Backstory_Ranger.title: Court ranger
LanguageData.WotF_Backstory_RepairApprentice.descript: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up following her workshop mentor to look after the settlement's few remaining old machines. Though she never understood why the parts inside those iron casings hummed, she learned early to solemnly draw a few marks on the shell and give it two light taps with a wooden mallet—and remarkably, the machines really did start running again every time.
LanguageData.WotF_Backstory_RepairApprentice.title: repair apprentice
LanguageData.WotF_Backstory_RuinExplorer.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was always rounding up a few friends her own age, strapping on makeshift tools, and sneaking off to explore an ancient ruin near the settlement. By unspoken agreement, the adults never broke it to her that they had already combed the site ten times over and dismantled every dangerous mechanism.
LanguageData.WotF_Backstory_RuinExplorer.title: ruin explorer
LanguageData.WotF_Backstory_Smith.description: Only a handful of smithies in the settlement are permitted to light a furnace, and [PAWN_nameDef] spends her years beside one of them. She patiently hammers unusual metal blanks again and again until they take shape as well-balanced weapons and armor.
LanguageData.WotF_Backstory_Smith.title: smith
LanguageData.WotF_Backstory_StoneSculptor.description: [PAWN_nameDef] carves stone pillars and statues for the settlement's plazas and altars. Her craft is beyond reproach, yet her unhurried pace drives others to distraction—once a promising block of stone is hauled into her yard, she can spend half a year leisurely polishing it.
LanguageData.WotF_Backstory_StoneSculptor.title: stone sculptor
LanguageData.WotF_Backstory_SwordGuard.description: A nimble melee guard. Favoring fitted light armor and a longsword, [PAWN_nameDef] rarely meets a foe head-on; instead, she works in close, slipping past clumsy heavy swings with quick footwork before striking back in the same motion.
LanguageData.WotF_Backstory_SwordGuard.title: elven sword guard
LanguageData.WotF_Backstory_Wanderer.description: Despite having centuries ahead of her, [PAWN_nameDef] had no desire to stay tied down by settlement rules. One day she simply slipped a wand into her pocket, left a note behind, and set off to roam—far more curious about whatever unseen novelties lay beyond the hills than about proper work.
LanguageData.WotF_Backstory_Wanderer.title: idle wanderer
LanguageData.WotF_Backstory_Woodshaper.description: [PAWN_nameDef] channels mana along the natural grain of living trees, coaxing growing branches into the shapes of bows, staves, and beams. Timber grown under her care is remarkably resilient and bears not a single saw mark.
LanguageData.WotF_Backstory_Woodshaper.title: woodshaper
